classification.difficultyReason: Parts a and b scaffold the method: find a time interval across am/pm (8:30 to 4 is 7.5 h), convert it to a decimal, then multiply by the rate. Part c is the hardest essential demand. The student must repeat the interval conversion for Tuesday (5.5 h), combine the two days and multiply by the rate. That needs more linked steps and time-to-decimal conversion than p11-q16's subtract-then-divide. It is easier than p11-q19, which has no scaffolding and asks for a whole week's hours across two different shift patterns before the wage.
